_doc: 4.0.5 national supercups of World 2026-27 (supercup.py table; internal/handoff/supercups.md). Per country: pack id suffix, names {lang: [long, short]}, article (FORMAT text: {lang: word} when not La / The / La), date (dd/mm, +1 = the next calendar year, the real 2026-27 edition), from_season (2 = summer: not in the world's first season), legs, level (pens | et_pens), host (neutral), rule [2 or 4 rules: e0 v e1 (and e2 v e3: semi-finals, then the final)] + if_double (one fallback for every rule after the first, or a list per rule: champion | second | third | fourth | cup_winner | cup_finalist | title0 | title1: last season's stage-title winners, the play-offs 'titles' [key0, key1]), final_date (4 clubs), first_entrants (pack club keys of the real 2026-27 edition: season 1), todo (what is not verified yet).

ita.todo: date 22 Dec and San Siro from the press, not official; extra time or straight penalties not verified (pens assumed)

esp.todo: Istanbul 2-7 Feb 2027: semi and final days differ between sources (3/2, 7/2 used); semi pairings by the usual rule (champion v cup finalist, cup winner v league 2nd), the 2027 draw not seen; extra time not verified (pens assumed); the double fallback (league 3rd) not verified

tur.todo: semis 4+5 Jan, final 9 Jan 2027 (TFF 24 Sep 2026); which entrant is which (rule) inferred from the 2027 pairs, venues TBA; extra time not verified (pens assumed); the double fallback not verified

eng.todo: the 2026 edition was played on 16 Aug at Cardiff (Wembley unavailable): from season 2 the same week, neutral; 90 minutes then penalties (no extra time) per the FA's usual rules, not re-checked for 2027; double -> league runner-up per the FA rule, not re-checked

ger.todo: 2026: 22 Aug at Dortmund (Bayern 2-1; Bayern's double -> Dortmund, league 2nd): from season 2 the same week; the real host is the 2nd club's ground (host 'neutral' in the engine); 90 minutes then penalties per the DFL rules, not re-checked for 2027

fra.todo: 2026: 16 Aug at Lens (host by draw), PSG v Lens: from season 2 the same week, neutral; Lens taken as the league 2nd after a PSG double, not verified; straight penalties assumed

ksa.todo: Kuwait 19/20 Dec, final 23 Dec 2026: the 2026 field is Al-Nassr (champion) v Al-Kholood (cup finalist) and Al-Ahli (3rd) v Al-Qadsiah (4th): Al-Hilal (league 2nd and cup winner?) banned; the engine rule is the usual one (champion v cup finalist, cup winner v league 2nd), the 2026 replacements only in season 1's entrants; pairings, extra time (pens assumed) and the double fallback not verified

mex.todo: Liga MX only (the Expansion's stays at the season end, real): the 2026 edition was played on 25 Jul 2026 at Carson (USA), Toluca (Apertura 2025) v Cruz Azul (Clausura 2026): from season 2 the same week, neutral; the season-end mex_cdc play-off must carry 'supercup': true (pack data) so it is not played twice; one club winning both tournaments: no match (as the pack's skip_if_same); 90 minutes then penalties assumed

bra.todo: Supercopa Rei 24 Jan 2027 (CBF calendar): Brasileirao 2026 champion v Copa do Brasil 2026 winner = the season before in the game too; the 2027 entrants are not known yet (both 2026 competitions end in December), so from season 2 (first_entrants = the 2026 edition's pair, unused); venue not seen (neutral); 90 minutes then penalties and the double fallback (league 2nd) not verified
